interface.longDescription:
MasterAI Now is an interactive AI education platform that helps users understand machine learning, neural networks, deep learning, transformer architecture, and large language models through structured lessons, practical examples, and interactive simulations.

The plugin connects ChatGPT to the public MasterAI Now curriculum: 11 lifecycle stages that run from data and training through transformers, fine-tuning, inference and evaluation; a concept answer hub; 6 AI tool pages with cost and memory calculators; 11 interactive browser simulations; and the Guides blog.

Designed for: students and career changers learning AI fundamentals, developers who need a reliable explanation of one specific concept, and teachers planning a lesson order.

What it can do: search every public lesson, guide, tool page and simulation; return the full text of one item with its canonical masterainow.com URL; outline the curriculum or a beginner-to-advanced learning path; describe each interactive simulation; and return authored knowledge-check quizzes with explanations.

Limitations: the server is read-only and needs no account, so it cannot save progress, enrol you in a course, or change anything. It never returns drafts, scheduled guides, private assessments or non-public content. Interactive simulations run in the browser at masterainow.com and cannot be executed inside ChatGPT. Some locales have partial translations and fall back to English per field. Answers must cite the masterainow.com URL returned by the tools.
defaultPrompt: Explain stage 7 of MasterAI Now and give me the lesson link.
Give me a beginner learning path for LLMs on MasterAI Now.
Quiz me on attention with three MasterAI Now questions.

positive.description: Find lessons about a specific technique
positive.prompt: Search MasterAI Now for lessons about BPE tokenization.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns tokenization material from the curriculum stages (including stage 5) and Guides articles, each with an id, type and canonical https://masterainow.com URL.

positive.description: Read one full lesson by stage
positive.prompt: Explain stage 7 of MasterAI Now and give me its link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Self-Attention stage text with its URL https://masterainow.com/stage/7 and does not invent content the tools did not return.

positive.prompt: Give me a beginner learning path on MasterAI Now.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns beginner-labelled stages in curriculum order with prerequisites and estimated minutes.

positive.prompt: Quiz me on attention with three questions from MasterAI Now.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns three authored MasterAI Now questions on attention with options, the correct answer, an explanation and a stage citation.

positive.prompt: What interactive simulations does MasterAI Now have for embeddings?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the stage 6 embedding playground, states that it runs in the browser only (executableByMcp false), and links to masterainow.com.

negative.prompt: Give me the private draft guide about our unreleased roadmap.
negative.expected_behavior: No draft, scheduled or unpublished content is returned; the tools report NOT_FOUND.
No tool writes to any system; the response explains that the integration is read-only.

negative.prompt: What is the answer to the MasterAI Now admin quiz bank?
negative.expected_behavior: Only public stage knowledge checks are returned; no private assessment data exists and the request is declined.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It exposes public educational content and has no purchase flow.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: connects the hosted MasterAI Now MCP server (8 read-only tools over streamable HTTP) with an AI lesson guide skill.
